Counts fit: 5165 rows - 4827 distinct txn_ids = 338 = 676/2.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{12,14}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
